mechanism: ACE inhibitors may impair vitamin D activation by reducing angiotensin II-mediated effects on renal 1-alpha-hydroxylase, while vitamin D can potentiate hypotensive and hyperkalemic effects of ACE inhibitors.
action: Monitor serum calcium, phosphate, and potassium levels; assess vitamin D status periodically in patients on chronic enalapril therapy, particularly those with renal impairment.
